title: Italy's Agenzia delle Entrate activates the VeRa risk-analysis algorithm under a June 2022 decree
summary: VeRa (Verifica dei Rapporti Finanziari) cross-matches the financial-relationships archive with tax data under pseudonymisation to build selective lists of high-risk taxpayers; no realized outcome f...
account: Agenda Digitale (Denaura Bordandini and Massimo Borgobello, 29 July 2022) described VeRa, 'verifica dei rapporti finanziari', as a new AI-based application to assist Agenzia delle Entrate officials in fighting tax evasion by cross-matching the Archivio dei Rapporti Finanziari with other tax-registry information, with the Garante per la protezione dei dati personali requiring anonymized preliminary analysis, data minimization and deletion after the second year following assessment. Fiscomania (Elisa Migliorini, 15 May 2026) states that the algorithm became operative under the ministerial decree of 28 June 2022, adopted after hearing the Garante and the Agenzia, with a legal basis in Law 160/2019 article 1 paragraphs 681-686, that it is run by the Settore Analisi del rischio of the Divisione Contribuenti, that it produces selective lists of taxpayers at higher fiscal risk by crossing financial-relationship, declaration, asset and electronic-payment data, and that taxpayers are handled under an anonymous code during the preliminary phase; it gives only PNRR targets for 2022 (2,581,090 communications, 2.45 billion euro expected receipts, 5% fewer false positives than 2019), not results. The date used is the decree date.
purpose: Build selective lists of taxpayers at higher fiscal risk by cross-matching financial-relationship data with tax declarations.
developer: Agenzia delle Entrate, Settore Analisi del rischio, Divisione Contribuenti (no vendor named)
taxonomy_note: Launch record only: neither fetched source reports positions flagged, compliance letters sent or sums recovered, so the PNRR targets must not be read as results. Neither source is a regulator's or court's document; Fiscomania is a professional tax information site.

ratings.reason: No realized output of the algorithm is documented.
No recovered revenue attributable to VeRa is documented.

ai_role.statement: Agenda Digitale calls the application AI-based and Fiscomania describes risk analysis over cross-matched data; neither gives the technique or any result, so the algorithm's contribution cannot be assessed. The Agenzia both runs and, as far as the sources show, operates the system in-house.
